metadata.description: Lucas's curated Claude Code skills and plugins, auto-synced daily from upstream

plugins.name: anthropic-skills
plugins.description: Curated skills from anthropics/skills: mcp-builder, skill-creator, webapp-testing

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive PR review agents specializing in comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality, and code simplification

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Commands for git commit workflows including commit, push, and PR creation

plugins.name: claude-security
plugins.description: Deep vulnerability scanning of your own code at a chosen effort tier, with every finding challenged before it is reported, and verified patches you apply when you choose

plugins.name: code-modernization
plugins.description: Modernize legacy codebases with a structured preflight / assess / map / extract-rules / brief / reimagine / transform / harden workflow and specialist review agents

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: Official Microsoft .NET plugin: Roslyn C# language server (via dnx, needs .NET 10 SDK) plus core .NET skills

plugins.name: dotnet-aspnetcore
plugins.description: ASP.NET Core web development skills including middleware, endpoints, real-time communication, and API patterns

plugins.name: dotnet-test
plugins.description: Skills and agents for running, generating, analyzing, and improving .NET tests: execution, filtering, coverage, testability, MSTest workflows

plugins.name: dotnet-data
plugins.description: Skills for .NET data access and Entity Framework related tasks

plugins.name: dotnet-nuget
plugins.description: NuGet and .NET package management: dependency management and modernization

plugins.name: dotnet-advanced
plugins.description: Advanced .NET and C# skills: file-based C# scripts, P/Invoke, vectorization, NuGet trusted publishing

plugins.name: azure-agent-skills
plugins.description: 32 of Microsoft's first-party Azure Agent Skills: Azure DevOps, Pipelines, Repos, Artifacts, Boards, Container Registry, AKS, Key Vault, RBAC, Monitor, Managed Grafana, Policy, Resource Manager, Cost Management, Logic Apps, Well-Architected, OpenTelemetry, Functions, and networking (VNet, DNS, Private Link, NAT, Load Balancer, App Gateway, WAF, Front Door, Firewall, Network Watcher, Bastion, VPN Gateway, DDoS). Each skill is a structured Microsoft Learn index; pair with the Learn MCP server

plugins.name: csharp-patterns
plugins.description: Curated C#/.NET design skills from Aaronontheweb/dotnet-skills: coding standards, concurrency, nullable types, API/type design, configuration, DI, serialization, project structure, package management, Testcontainers, AOT

plugins.name: powershell
plugins.description: PowerShell skill: safe native-command invocation, quoting, escaping, encoding and Start-Process rules (Misaka-Mikoto-Tech/agent-skills)

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills: grill-me / grill-with-docs interviews, to-spec, to-tickets, TDD, domain modeling, triage, implement, handoff and more (code-review excluded; run setup-matt-pocock-skills once per repo)

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents (Vercel Labs): navigate, fill forms, screenshot, extract data, test web apps; install.sh sets up the CLI and Chrome

plugins.name: spec-kit
plugins.description: Bootstraps GitHub Spec Kit (Spec-Driven Development) in a project and guides the constitution → specify → clarify → plan → tasks → implement workflow; the speckit-* skills are generated by the Spec Kit CLI

plugins.name: component-documentation
plugins.description: Repo-owned skill: writes complete operational documentation for one infrastructure component (purpose, architecture, deployment order, per-environment config, availability, monitoring, backup/recovery, runbooks, risks, ownership) with section packs for ingress, telemetry, alerting, security tooling, cluster services and Terraform

plugins.name: codebase-onboarding
plugins.description: Generate a DeepWiki-style, source-linked, diagram-rich wiki for any repository to learn how its code works (eabait/codebase-onboarding-skill; optional `pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt` for deeper analysis)

plugins.name: terraform
plugins.description: HashiCorp Terraform MCP server (runs via docker): registry, provider and module docs lookup for IaC work

plugins.name: pyright-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server (Pyright) for type checking and code intelligence; requires `npm i -g pyright`

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode: cuts ~65% of output tokens by talking like caveman while keeping technical accuracy
